```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
```

# Load data
```{r}
ss <- "1Bv0_BjwayZBXeYDtM439AdTjKdH16fvQfarGahmzVSc"
df_data_a <- read_sheet(ss, "Alvin")
df_data_g <- read_sheet(ss, "Gianmatteo")
df_data_f <- read_sheet(ss, "Federica")
df_main <- read_sheet(ss, "main")
df_paired_wide <- read_sheet(ss, "paired")

as_chr1 <- function(x) {
  if (!is.list(x)) return(as.character(x))
  map_chr(x, \(y) {
    if (is.null(y) || length(y) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    y1 <- y[[1]]
    if (is.null(y1) || is.na(y1)) NA_character_ else as.character(y1)
  })
}

as_num1 <- function(x) {
  v <- as_chr1(x) |>
    str_remove(" \\(.*\\)") |>
    str_trim()
  v[str_to_lower(v) %in% c("na", "/", "not available")] <- NA_character_
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(v))
  ok <- !is.na(v) & str_detect(v, "^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$")
  out[ok] <- as.numeric(v[ok])
  out
}

clean_df <- function(df_dat) {
  df_dat |> 
    mutate(across(c(has_full_text, compare_group), as_chr1)) |>
    filter_out(str_detect(has_full_text, "exclude"),
               str_detect(compare_group, "exclude")) |> 
    mutate(across(where(is.list), as_num1),
           notes = coalesce(notes, `...35`),
           across(where(is.character), \(x) na_if(x, "/"))) |> 
    select(-`...35`)
}

df_data_f <- bind_rows(
  df_data_f |> 
    mutate(compare_group = map(
      compare_group, 
      \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), NA,
                  replace_values(as.character(x),
                                 "1 & 2" ~ "1",
                                 "3 & 4" ~ "3",
                                 "5 & 6" ~ "5"
                  )))),
  df_data_f |> 
    filter(map_lgl(compare_group, \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), FALSE, str_detect(x, " & ")))) |> 
    mutate(compare_group = map(
      compare_group, 
      \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), NA,
                  replace_values(as.character(x),
                                 "1 & 2" ~ "2",
                                 "3 & 4" ~ "4",
                                 "5 & 6" ~ "6"
                  ))))
)

df_data_raw <- bind_rows(
  df_data_a |>
    filter(is.na(exclusion_reason)) |>
    mutate(compare_group = as_chr1(compare_group)),
  clean_df(df_data_g),
  clean_df(df_data_f)
) |> 
  select(-starts_with("clt_"))

df_paired_long <- df_paired_wide |>
  mutate(pair_id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("_(1|2)$"),
    names_to = c(".value", "side"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(1|2)$"
  )
```

# Exclusions
```{r}
df_exclusions <- bind_rows(
  df_data_a |> 
    filter(!is.na(exclusion_reason)) |> 
    mutate(compare_group = map_chr(compare_group, \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), "", as.character(x)))) |> 
    select(long_cite, short_cite, has_full_text, compare_group, exclusion_reason, notes),
  df_data_g |> 
    mutate(compare_group = map_chr(compare_group, \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), "", as.character(x)))) |> 
    filter(str_detect(has_full_text, "exclude") |
             str_detect(compare_group, "exclude") |
             notes == "no comparison") |> 
    select(long_cite, short_cite, has_full_text, compare_group, notes),
  df_data_f |> 
    mutate(compare_group = map_chr(compare_group, \(x) ifelse(is.null(x), "", as.character(x)))) |> 
    filter(str_detect(has_full_text, "exclude") |
             str_detect(compare_group, "exclude") |
             notes == "no comparison") |> 
    select(long_cite, short_cite, has_full_text, compare_group, notes),
) |> 
  mutate(exclusion_reason = case_when(
    !is.na(exclusion_reason) ~ exclusion_reason,
    notes == "no comparison" ~ "no comparison",
    str_detect(compare_group, "exclude") ~ compare_group,
    str_detect(has_full_text, "exclude") ~ has_full_text,
    has_full_text == "no" ~ "no full text",
    .default = NA
  )) |> 
  select(long_cite, short_cite, exclusion_reason) |> 
  bind_rows(df_main |> 
              mutate(has_full_text = str_replace_all(has_full_text, 
                                                     "(exclue|exlculde|excude)", "exclude")) |> 
              filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(has_full_text), "exclude")) |> 
              select(long_cite, short_cite, exclusion_reason = has_full_text)) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite) |> 
  summarise(exclusion_reason = str_c(exclusion_reason, collapse = " / "),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(exclusion_reason = exclusion_reason |> str_to_lower() |> 
           str_remove_all("excluded? ? ?") |> str_remove_all(" / ma"))

write_csv(df_exclusions |> select(exclusion_reason) |> distinct(), here("data", "exclusions.csv"))
df_exclusions_cleaned <- read_csv(here("data", "exclusions_cleaned.csv"))
df_exclusions <- df_exclusions |> 
  mutate(exclusion_reason = str_replace(exclusion_reason, " / $", " /")) |> 
  left_join(df_exclusions_cleaned, by = join_by(exclusion_reason))
df_exclusions <- df_exclusions |>
  filter(!long_cite %in% df_paired_wide$long_cite)
df_exclusion_summary <- df_exclusions |> 
  group_by(exclusion_reason_cleaned) |> 
  summarise(n = n())
df_data_raw <- bind_rows(
  df_data_raw |> filter(!(long_cite %in% df_exclusions$long_cite)),
  df_paired_long |>
    mutate(compare_group = as_chr1(compare_group)) |>
    select(-side, -pair_id, -t_df, -t_score, -F_df1, -F_df2, -F_score)
)

# sanity check
df_main |> 
  filter(!long_cite %in% c(df_data_raw$long_cite, df_exclusions$long_cite),
         !inclusion_decision_new %in% c("E+E", "M+E")) |> 
  View()
```

# Standardisation
```{r}
clean_lang <- function(lang) {
  lang |> 
    str_replace_all("French, English,  \\(n = 1 Hebrew, n = 1 Turkish, and n = 4 Italian\\)", "various") |> 
    str_remove_all(" ?\\(.*\\) ?") |> 
    str_remove_all("\"]") |> 
    str_remove_all("-speaking") |> 
    str_replace_all("( and |, | or )", "/") |> 
    str_remove_all("\\.$") |> 
    str_remove_all("[0-9]+%? ?") |> 
    replace_when(
      str_detect(lang, "([Dd]ifferent|mixed|[Oo]ther|:|non-?English|Moroccan)") ~ "various",
      str_detect(lang, "(^/$|^na|^n=|Not reported)") ~ NA,
      str_detect(lang, "Peruvian") ~ "Quechua/Spanish",
      lang == "english" ~ "English"
    )
}

df_data_cleaned <- df_data_raw |> 
  mutate(
    lang_group = lang_group |> 
      str_to_lower() |> 
      str_replace_all(
        c(" \\(.*" = "",
          "multi/bilingual" = "multilingual",
          "bilngual" = "bilingual")
      ),
    vocab_measure = vocab_measure |> 
      str_to_lower() |> 
      str_replace_all(
        c(
          " vocabulary" = "",
          " spe" = "-spe",
          " \\(english\\)" = "",
          "cifc" = "cific"
        )
      ) |> na_if("/"),
    vocab_measure = ifelse(lang_group == "monolingual" & is.na(vocab_measure),
                           "language-specific", vocab_measure),
    across(c(L1, L2), clean_lang),
    N = str_remove_all(N, " \\(.*\\)"),
    assessment_tool_L1 = na_if(assessment_tool_L1, "na"),
    assessment_tool_L1 = na_if(assessment_tool_L1, "Not reported"),
    assessment_tool_L2 = na_if(assessment_tool_L2, "na")) |> 
  filter(vocab_type %in% c("receptive", "expressive"),
         !is.na(compare_group))

df_data_cleaned |> 
  select(infant_type, L1, L2, is_plurilingual, bilingual_type, 
         country, assessment_tool_L1, assessment_tool_L2, vocab_units) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |> 
  mutate(variable = replace_values(variable,
                                   c("L1", "L2") ~ "lang",
                                   c("assessment_tool_L1", "assessment_tool_L2") ~ "assessment_tool")) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(variable, value) |> 
  write_csv(here("data", "variable_mapping.csv"))

var_map <- read_csv(here("data", "variable_mapping_std.csv")) |> 
  mutate(variable = map(variable, \(v) {
    if (v == "lang") return(c("L1", "L2"))
    if (v == "assessment_tool") return(c("assessment_tool_L1", "assessment_tool_L2"))
    v
  })) |> 
  unnest(variable)

df_data_std <- df_data_cleaned |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(infant_type, L1, L2, is_plurilingual, bilingual_type, 
                        country, assessment_tool_L1, assessment_tool_L2, vocab_units), 
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |> 
  left_join(var_map, by = join_by(variable, value)) |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = std_value,
              values_fn = \(x) x[1])
```

```{r}
df_data <- df_data_std |>
  mutate(
    N                = as.numeric(N),
    vocab_score_mean = as.numeric(vocab_score_mean),
    vocab_score_sd   = as.numeric(vocab_score_sd),
    age_mean         = as.numeric(age_mean) |> 
      coalesce(rowMeans(cbind(age_max, age_min))),
    infant_typical   = infant_type == "typical"
  )

saveRDS(df_data, here("outputs", "df_data.rds"))

df_paired <- df_paired_long |>
  select(pair_id, side, t_df, t_score, F_df1, F_df2, F_score,
         short_cite, compare_group, ppt_group, vocab_type, vocab_measure) |>
  mutate(across(c(compare_group, ppt_group), as.numeric)) |>
  inner_join(
    df_data |> mutate(across(c(compare_group, ppt_group), as.numeric)),
    by = join_by(short_cite, compare_group, ppt_group, vocab_type, vocab_measure)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = side,
    values_from = c(ppt_group, lang_group, N, age_mean, age_sd, age_min, age_max,
                    L1_definition, L1, L2, is_plurilingual, bilingual_type, country,
                    assessment_tool_L1, assessment_tool_L2, vocab_score_mean, vocab_score_sd),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{side}"
  ) |>
  select(-pair_id)

saveRDS(df_paired, here("outputs", "df_paired.rds"))
```

## General

```{r}
df_data$long_cite |> n_distinct()
```

```{r}
sum_n <- df_data |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite, ppt_group) |> 
  slice_max(N, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite) |> 
  summarise(N = sum(N), .groups = "drop")

sum_n$N |> range()
sum_n$N |> mean()
sum_n$N |> median()
sum_n$N |> sum()
sum_n |> filter(N >= 50) |> nrow()
sum_n |> filter(N >= 100) |> nrow()
```

```{r}
sum_age <- df_data |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite, ppt_group) |> 
  slice(1) |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite) |> 
  summarise(age_mean = mean(age_mean), .groups = "drop")

sum_age$age_mean |> range()
sum_age$age_mean |> mean()
sum_age$age_mean |> median()
```

```{r}
sum_typical <- df_data |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite) |> 
  summarise(all_typical = all(infant_typical == 1),

            all_atypical = all(infant_typical == 0),
            .groups = "drop")

sum_typical$all_typical |> sum()

sum_typical$all_atypical |> sum()
```

## Languages

```{r}
lang_fam <- read_csv(here("data", "language_families.csv"))

sum_lang <- df_data |> 
  group_by(long_cite, short_cite) |> 
  summarise(all_lang = paste(L1, L2, sep = ",", collapse = ",") |> 
              str_split(","),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  unnest(all_lang) |> 
  filter(all_lang != "NA") |> 
  distinct()

sum_sum_lang <- sum_lang |> 
  count(all_lang) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  mutate(all_lang = replace_values(all_lang, "zzz" ~ "various")) |> 
  left_join(lang_fam, by = join_by(all_lang == lang)) |> 
  mutate(all_lang = fct_reorder(all_lang, desc(n)))

sum_fam_lang <- sum_sum_lang |> 
  group_by(family) |> 
  summarise(n = sum(n),
            n_lang = n())

sum_sum_lang <- sum_sum_lang |> 
  mutate(family_collapsed = case_when(
           str_starts(family, "IE: [CSAH]") ~ "IE: Other",
           is.na(family) ~ NA,
           family %in% (sum_fam_lang |> filter(n_lang <= 2) |> pull(family)) ~ "Other",
           .default = family
         ) |> factor(levels = c("IE: Germanic", "IE: Romance", "IE: Indo-Iranian", "IE: Other",
                                "Semitic", "Sinitic", "Other")))

write_csv(sum_sum_lang, here("outputs", "descriptives_lang.csv"))

# add colour based on language family
sum_sum_lang |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = all_lang, y = n, fill = family_collapsed)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Language", y = "Number of studies", fill = "Language family") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.88, .67))
```

```{r}
sum_langp <- df_data |> 
  mutate(across(c(L1, L2), \(l) str_split(l, ","))) |> 
  unnest(c(L1, L2)) |> 
  mutate(langp = map2_chr(L1, L2, \(a, b) {
    if (is.na(a) | is.na(b)) NA_character_
    else if (a < b) paste(a, b, sep = "/")
    else paste(b, a, sep = "/")
  })) |> 
  select(long_cite, short_cite, langp) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  filter(!is.na(langp))

sum_sum_langp <- sum_langp |> 
  count(langp) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  mutate(langp = str_replace_all(langp, "zzz", "various"))

write_csv(sum_sum_langp, here("outputs", "descriptives_lang_pairs.csv"))

sum_sum_langp |> 
  separate_wider_delim(langp, "/", names = c("lang1", "lang2")) |> 
  select(-n) |> 
  filter(lang2 != "various") |> 
  write_csv("pairs_bnma.csv")
```

```{r}

  select(long_cite, short_cite, vocab_type) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(value = 1) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = vocab_type, values_from = value)

sum_domain$receptive |> is.na() |> sum()
sum_domain$expressive |> is.na() |> sum()
sum(sum_domain$receptive & sum_domain$expressive, na.rm = T)
```

```{r}
sum(rowSums(sum_measure |> select(`language-specific`, conceptual, total), na.rm = T) > 1)
```
